instruction: Set the primary mouse button to Right and leave it set that way.
gt_steps: Change Primary mouse button to Right.
Leave Right selected as the primary mouse button.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Add-Type -TypeDefinition 'using System; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; public static class MouseState { [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern int GetSystemMetrics(int nIndex); }'; $swapped = [MouseState]::GetSystemMetrics(23); if ($swapped -ne 0) { Write-Output 'PRIMARY_BUTTON_RIGHT' } else { Write-Output 'PRIMARY_BUTTON_LEFT' }"
